Indeed, even if WLM had a legitimate ownership interest in some of the funds in its account, it has not shown such an interest in the funds at issue here. WLM denies having any relationship with the entities that wired the funds. Accordingly, WLM was not injured by the forfeiture of the funds and its appeal is DISMISSED for lack of jurisdiction.
